answer: Resist sybils with pairwise-discounted funding: influence and matching rewards count each pair of supporters only once, scaled by how independent their funding sources are. An honest agent gathers backing from a velvet-soft spread of truly separate patrons, each one a clear signal of real demand. A farmer's thousand clones all trace to one wallet, one oasis of cash, so their pairwise bonus collapses to a single connection and cloning buys nothing.
